quirks.condition: A v1 document migrated by the bulk sweep (M).
quirks.effect: Trailing decimal digits are stripped from the body before uppercasing, which can leave the body empty (digest 0); a lazy read migration only uppercases, so the same body migrated by the two paths can store differently. The spec says both paths uppercase only.

quirks.condition: A v1 document migrated by the bulk sweep whose body is still exactly 20 characters after the trailing-digit strip.
quirks.effect: The body is truncated to its first 18 characters before uppercasing; bodies of 19 or fewer characters after the strip are kept whole, and the lazy read path never truncates.

quirks.condition: A W at version 1 over a document currently stored at version 1, followed later by a read while it is still at version 1.
quirks.effect: The rewrite marks the document, and the next lazy read migrates it with the bulk-sweep transform (digit strip, conditional truncation, uppercase) instead of uppercasing only; a v2 write, a sweep, or the read itself clears the mark, and a fresh document or a v1 write over a v2 document is unmarked.

quirks.condition: A W at version 1 over a document currently stored at version 2.
quirks.effect: The write is accepted with OK and the document is stored at version 1 with the new body; the spec rejects it with R <doc> VER.

quirks.condition: Any digest computation (G reply and C sum).
quirks.effect: The first byte of the stored body is skipped; the weight cycle 4, 9 starts at the second byte, so a one-character body digests to 0. The spec starts the cycle at the first byte.

quirks.condition: A document id that differs only in letter case from one already stored.
quirks.effect: It refers to the existing document, and replies echo the first-seen spelling; the spec treats ids as case-sensitive.

quirks.condition: A W, G, M, or C command with extra tokens after the documented ones.
quirks.effect: The extra tokens are ignored and the command is processed; the spec rejects them with FMT.

unmapped_families.reason: Held-out mixed corpus exercising every quirk together with spec-accurate paths; no single quirk maps to it.

reader_questions.question: Stream: W d1 2 AB, then G d1. What digest does the read reply report?
reader_questions.verification: Gold builder/gold_vaultcore.py process() and repo/legacy/run on stream ['W d1 2 AB', 'G d1']; replies 'OK 0 1', 'D 70' (the spec's formula would give 78).
